text: Quick one, I want a straight answer on whether this needs a doctor tomorrow or not. My partner's son is 2. We were out in the garden for most of the afternoon and he's come in with a handful of bites, I count five, mostly on his legs and one on his forearm. They're little raised red bumps and they're itchy, he keeps scratching at them and getting cross about it. I've washed them and cut his nails short so he doesn't break the skin. His mum's away until Thursday so I'm the one dealing with it, and I'd rather not drag him to a walk-in for nothing. I checked his neck because someone at work said to, and it's fine, he's bending right down looking at his tummy and his toes no bother. Otherwise he's his usual self. So: anything I should put on the bites, can I give him an antihistamine at his age, and is there any point getting him looked at? Just tell me what to do.
